d: Prashant Kishor On JDU Future: kya JDU ab tutne ki kagar par hai.... kya nitish kumar ki parti ka rajnitik astitv khatm hone vala hai.... kya aane vale dinon men JDU ke neta bijepi aur jan suraj ka daman tham sakte hain....aur kya nitish kumar ke lie bihar ki rajniti men naee mushkilen khari hone vali hain.... aakhir achanak bihar ki siyasat men is tarah ke saval kyon uthne lage hain....kyon JDU ke bhavishy ko lekar charchaen tej ho gaee hain....in tamam savalon ke pichhe hai jan suraj ke pramukh prashant kishor ki ek bari rajnitik bhavishyavani....lekin aakhir prashant kishor ne aisa kya…
